correctness.rationale: Smooth iff a²!=4 from x(x6+ax3+1). The genus-three Hasse–Witt coefficients are diagonal because all nonzero powers after factoring x15 have multiples of 3; diagonal is A(a),B(a),A(a). Reconstructed multinomial coefficient polynomials over F31, factored A=-4a(a-12)(a+12)(a²-12), and computed gcd(A,B)=a(a²+11), squarefreeness and exclusion a=+/-2. Geometric stable Frobenius rank equals number of nonzero diagonal entries. Independently computed common gcd of all entries for the 8 smaller primes, all either 1 or a; hence first nonzero superspecial occurs at p=31 among primes >=5. No claims for p=2,3 or moduli-isomorphism classes.
